claim: Media Studio main has a bounded current-checkout Flatpak-builder/runtime smoke job and a protected manual VAAPI/NVENC self-hosted hardware matrix. This claim is limited to source-level workflow correctness and does not claim production Flatpak sandbox readiness, host integration readiness, reproducible builds, or universal GPU availability.

output.claim_status: Supported at the stated source-level scope; external execution remains unverified.
output.summary: The supplied workflows and scripts provide the required bounded Flatpak build/install/runtime path and protected VAAPI/NVENC matrix with fail-closed hardware checks. No material defect is evident in the bound files.
evidence_gaps: No completed GitHub CI logs or trusted runner results were supplied.
Self-hosted device access, runner labels, and environment protection require external provisioning verification.
CLI/profile definitions and log-path behavior are not included in the bound sources.
supported_claims: ci.yml invokes flatpak-builder, installs media-studio.flatpak, and runs the packaged command inside Flatpak under a bounded push-only job.
gpu.yml restricts execution to manual dispatches on upstream main and uses explicit self-hosted backend labels.
hardware-smoke.sh checks exact encoders, disables fallback, validates and decodes output, and rejects fallback markers.
The packaging job enforces release/CI manifest parity and the xdg-data/kio permission contract.
prohibited_claims: Production Flatpak sandbox or host-integration readiness.
residual_risks: The push-only privileged builder and mutable action/runtime references remain supply-chain and reproducibility risks outside the claim.
GPU coverage remains unverified when no trusted runner is available.
